title: 恒科扩容补入科技与先进制造，新增成份股开盘承压仍待确认
summary: 恒生指数公司11月20日季度检讨将恒生科技指数成份股由30只扩至50只，12月4日收市后实施、12月7日起生效，宁德时代H股、长飞光纤、ASMPT、中际旭创H股等20只获纳入。09:30 CST开盘快照显示上证跌0.86%、深证跌0.98%、恒生科技跌1.92%；长飞、ASMPT、中际旭创H股和宁德时代H股分别跌4.71%、3.91%、3.47%和2.45%，扩容带来的中期被动资金预期尚未获得即时价格确认。华友钴业涨2.00%、通威股份涨1.53%，获得初步但有限的价格反馈；海油工程跌1.12%、天孚通信跌2.23%，不升级为多头。

关键词云图

科技抛售两融托底芯片重挫期指反弹数字园区光通信扩产锂电回购海工订单光伏承压智能物流长债高位恒科扩容
利好利空中性w1-w5表示重要性，不等于涨跌幅。
重大新闻汇总
国际
全球科技股遭遇新一轮去风险
11月20日标普500跌3.7%、纳指跌5.28%，费城半导体指数跌10.7%；芯片、AI硬件和数据中心链成为主要抛售来源，亚洲芯片市场周一仍面临传导压力。 来源
国际
亚洲监管机构准备稳定市场，周一期指反弹
韩国准备在必要时启用稳定基金，台湾收紧卖空规则；截至08:16 CST附近，道指、标普500和纳指100期货约涨1.4%、2.0%和2.7%，但韩国股市开盘仍一度跌逾3%，显示修复与抛压并存。 来源
指数
恒生科技指数将由30只扩容至50只
恒生指数公司季度检讨新增宁德时代H股、长飞光纤、ASMPT、中际旭创H股等20只成份股，调整于12月4日收市后实施、12月7日起生效；模拟权重中宁德时代H股约2.17%、长飞约0.94%、ASMPT约0.87%。扩容带来中期被动资金与科技制造映射，但09:30快照中长飞、ASMPT、中际旭创H股和宁德时代H股分别跌4.71%、3.91%、3.47%和2.45%，不得包装成即时多头确认。 来源
政策
沪深北交易所下调融资保证金比例
经证监会批准，融资买入证券的最低保证金比例由100%降至80%，11月30日起实施；有助于释放融资空间，但同时要求券商对异常交易从严管理。 来源
政策
交易所进一步减免费用降低市场成本
沪深交易所公布费用减免安排，覆盖交易单元、上市及部分债券和资产支持证券费用；属于市场成本端托底，不等于短线风险已经解除。 来源
产业
首批91家高标准数字园区建设对象公布
工信部与商务部要求推进园区产业、服务和管理数字化，夯实数字基础设施；工业软件、通信与边缘计算获得中期场景线索，但需订单和预算验证。 来源
科技
半导体、硬件和太阳能领跌映射A/H成长链
Moomoo快照显示半导体、计算机硬件、太阳能和半导体设备分别跌12.15%、11.04%、10.37%和8.92%；PXLW、AMCI、SNSC和SMTK虽逆势上涨，但板块宽度分别仅2涨67跌、6涨39跌、1涨21跌和1涨30跌。A/H映射聚焦芯片设备、CPO、服务器与光伏，开盘先看止跌而非追涨。 来源
公司
天孚通信拟建设新一代高速光器件项目
公司拟在南昌建设高速光器件研发和生产项目，服务超算和大型数据中心；项目预计不对2026年业绩产生重大影响，且11月20日股价跌6.84%，全球硬件链大跌构成明确反证。 来源
公司
华友钴业拟10亿至15亿元回购股份
回购价格上限45元/股，拟用于维护公司价值及股东权益；09:30快照报29.07元、涨2.00%，回购催化获得初步价格反馈，但仍需量价持续性与实际回购执行验证。 来源
公司
海油工程签署约8亿美元总包合同
公司与卡塔尔能源签署MM-EPIC2总包合同，建设期66个月；长周期合同提供订单能见度，但油价略回落、执行周期长，需公告后量价与项目进度确认。 来源
公司
兰剑智能签订2.84亿元物流线设备合同
合同标的为化成分容物流线设备，若顺利履行将支持2027年业绩；客户验收、交付节奏和回款仍是主要不确定性。 来源

美股夜盘行情总结

1
夜盘指数
截至08:16 CST附近，道指、标普500与纳指100期货约涨1.4%、2.0%和2.7%，10年期美债收益率约4.95%，原油期货小幅回落。以上为媒体转述的CME期指近实时快照，不是美股个股盘前成交。 来源
2
板块对照
美股个股盘前尚未开放，CNF、BMGL、UNH、BGS、PSMT、SMTK、RAYA、SNSC、AMCI、PXLW、APA、JNJ、BIIB和CVX均无本轮可验证夜盘报价，不能默认延续。指数期指反弹与半导体、硬件、太阳能隔夜暴跌方向相反，暂记为潜在反转；抵押贷款金融、医疗设施、页岩油与CAR-T缺少个股确认。 来源
3
A/H 映射
恒科扩容把宁德时代H股、光通信和半导体设备纳入更宽的科技基准，但09:30新增成份股样本普跌，属于中期映射而非即时多头确认。A股华友与通威仅获初步正反馈，海油工程与天孚继续受负面价格反馈约束。 来源

盘前结论

事实：09:30上证、深证和恒生科技分别跌0.86%、0.98%和1.92%；恒科新增成份股长飞、ASMPT、中际旭创H股、宁德时代H股跌2.45%至4.71%。

判断：恒科由30只扩至50只是中期被动资金与科技制造覆盖扩大的结构线索，但生效日在12月7日，今天的负面价格反馈不支持即时追涨。华友与通威仅获初步确认，海油工程与天孚不升级。

不确定性：09:30为开盘快照，量价持续性尚未建立；全球科技去风险、A股弱宽度及扩容前资金再平衡都可能放大波动。

重点个股关注

华友钴业
603799.SH
条件关注
事实与状态：周末披露10亿至15亿元回购、上限45元/股；09:30报29.07元、涨2.00%，获得初步但有限的公告后价格确认。
确认条件：11月23日开盘后放量跑赢锂电与新能源金属板块，且回购执行进度得到后续公告验证。
风险与失效条件：若高开回落、继续弱于板块，或锂电与电气设备全球弱势扩散，则维持观察而不升级。
海油工程
600583.SH
条件关注
事实与状态：签署约8亿美元MM-EPIC2总包合同，建设期66个月；09:30报6.16元、跌1.12%，公告后价格反馈为负。
确认条件：开盘后成交量放大、相对油服板块走强，并由项目进度或订单执行提供持续证据。
风险与失效条件：油价继续回落、项目执行或回款延迟，或股价弱于油服板块时，条件关注失效。
天孚通信
300394.SZ
回避
事实与状态：拟建高速光器件项目，但预计不对2026年业绩产生重大影响；09:30报99.90元、跌2.23%，且恒科新增光通信成份股同步承压。
重新评估条件：公告后止跌、放量跑赢CPO板块，并出现可核验订单、产能利用率或交付进展。
风险与失效条件：全球AI硬件抛售延续或项目兑现周期拉长时，维持回避，不能用扩产标题覆盖负面价格反馈。
通威股份
600438.SH
条件关注
事实与状态：周末披露10亿至20亿元回购线索；09:30报11.28元、涨1.53%，出现初步价格反馈，但隔夜太阳能行业跌10.37%的反证仍在。
重新评估条件：A股光伏开盘止跌、公司获得量价确认，并由回购实际成交或产业价格改善提供支撑。
风险与失效条件：若光伏继续领跌、回购执行弱或供需压力延续，维持回避。

板块轮动看板

结构线索

恒科扩容覆盖电池、光通信、半导体设备、AI基础设施与先进制造，中期被动资金预期更分散。

初步确认

华友钴业涨2.00%、通威股份涨1.53%，只记开盘初步反馈，仍需成交量与板块相对强弱验证。

压力方向

恒生科技跌1.92%，长飞、ASMPT、中际旭创H股、宁德时代H股均下跌，扩容消息未形成即时多头确认。

验证信号

观察扩容成份股能否收复开盘跌幅、恒科相对恒指是否转强，以及A股科技与新能源宽度能否改善。

逻辑链

恒科30扩50、12月7日生效 → 被动资金与覆盖面中期增加 → 电池、光通信、半导体设备和AI基础设施获得基准映射。
新增成份股09:30普遍下跌 → 资金流预期未形成即时确认 → 不把纳入消息包装成当日追涨理由。
华友与通威开盘上涨 → 回购线索获得初步反馈 → 仍需量价持续、板块相对强势与实际执行验证。
海油工程与天孚开盘下跌 → 合同和扩产标题未覆盖负面价格反馈 → 维持条件观察或回避。

风险雷达

恒生科技开盘跌1.92%，新增成份股代表样本跌2.45%至4.71%，扩容前可能存在再平衡与获利了结波动。
上证与深证开盘分别跌0.86%和0.98%，11月20日极弱市场宽度尚未被逆转。
隔夜半导体、硬件和太阳能的大幅负反馈仍在，指数扩容不改变全球科技去风险。
扩容12月7日才生效，模拟权重不是确定资金流；实际跟踪资金、自由流通调整与价格可能变化。
09:30仅是开盘快照，华友和通威的正反馈也可能回落，不能据此承诺收益。

数据来源与时间点

国内发现源：东方财富、上海证券报与巨潮资讯；原始源：上交所、深交所、工信部、商务部、恒生指数公司及上市公司法定披露，增量检索截至2026-11-23 09:30 CST。指数调整以恒生指数公司2026年11月20日季度检讨公告为准；开盘行情为东方财富公开延时接口09:30 CST快照。国际与隔夜行情源：Reuters、AP、CME期指媒体快照及GitHub Actions Moomoo榜单。更新时间：2026-11-23 09:30 CST。

Market Keywords

Tech selloffMargin supportChip routFutures reboundDigital parksOptical expansionBattery buybackOffshore orderSolar pressureSmart logisticsHigh yieldsHSTECH expansion
BullishBearishNeutral
Major News
Global
Global technology shares face another de-risking wave
On Nov. 20 the S&P 500 fell 3.7%, the Nasdaq 5.28% and the PHLX Semiconductor Index 10.7%. Chips, AI hardware and data-center exposures led the selling, leaving Asian chip markets exposed on Monday. Source
Global
Asian regulators prepare support as Monday futures rebound
South Korea stood ready to deploy a stabilization fund and Taiwan tightened short-selling rules. Near 08:16 CST, Dow, S&P 500 and Nasdaq-100 futures rose about 1.4%, 2.0% and 2.7%, while Korea still opened down more than 3%. Source
Index
Hang Seng Tech will expand from 30 to 50 constituents
The quarterly review adds 20 names including CATL H, Yangtze Optical Fibre, ASMPT and Innolight H. Changes will be implemented after the Dec. 4 close and take effect Dec. 7; simulated weights are about 2.17% for CATL H, 0.94% for Yangtze Optical Fibre and 0.87% for ASMPT. The expansion creates medium-term passive-flow and advanced-manufacturing exposure, but the 09:30 snapshot showed these four names down 2.45%-4.71%, so it is not an immediate bullish confirmation. Source
Policy
Mainland exchanges lower the margin-financing requirement
With CSRC approval, the minimum margin ratio for financed securities purchases falls from 100% to 80% on Nov. 30. The move releases financing capacity but also tightens controls on abnormal trading. Source
Policy
Exchanges extend fee reductions
Shanghai and Shenzhen announced fee relief covering trading units, listings and selected bond and asset-backed securities services. It supports market costs but does not remove near-term risk. Source
Industry
China names the first 91 high-standard digital parks
MIIT and MOFCOM called for industrial, service and management digitization plus stronger infrastructure. Industrial software, communications and edge computing gain a medium-term signal, subject to orders and budgets. Source
Tech
Semiconductors, hardware and solar lead losses
Moomoo showed semiconductors, computer hardware, solar and semiconductor equipment down 12.15%, 11.04%, 10.37% and 8.92%. PXLW, AMCI, SNSC and SMTK rose, but breadth was just 2/67, 6/39, 1/21 and 1/30. The A/H mapping covers chip equipment, CPO, servers and solar, where stabilization matters more than headline winners. Source
Company
TFC Optical plans a next-generation high-speed optics project
The Nanchang project targets hyperscale and large data centers, but is not expected to materially affect 2026 earnings. The shares fell 6.84% on Nov. 20 and the global hardware rout is clear counterevidence. Source
Company
Huayou Cobalt plans a RMB1.0-1.5bn buyback
The cap is RMB45 per share and the plan aims to protect shareholder value. At the 09:30 snapshot the shares were RMB29.07, up 2.00%, an initial positive reaction that still requires volume persistence and actual buyback execution. Source
Company
COOEC signs an approximately $800m EPC contract
The MM-EPIC2 contract with QatarEnergy has a 66-month construction period. It improves order visibility, but the long execution cycle, slightly lower oil and project delivery still require confirmation. Source
Company
BlueSword signs a RMB284m logistics-equipment contract
The project covers formation-and-capacity logistics equipment and could support 2027 earnings if executed. Acceptance, delivery timing and collection remain key risks. Source

US Overnight Trading Summary

1
Overnight index futures
Near 08:16 CST, Dow, S&P 500 and Nasdaq-100 futures rose about 1.4%, 2.0% and 2.7%; the 10-year Treasury yield was near 4.95% and crude futures eased slightly. These are near-live CME futures relayed by market media, not US stock premarket trades. Source
2
Sector cross-check
US stock premarket had not opened, so CNF, BMGL, UNH, BGS, PSMT, SMTK, RAYA, SNSC, AMCI, PXLW, APA, JNJ, BIIB and CVX had no verifiable overnight quotes and cannot be assumed to extend. Futures moved opposite Friday's semiconductor, hardware and solar rout, a potential reversal; mortgage finance, medical facilities, shale oil and CAR-T lacked stock confirmation. Source
3
A/H mapping
Lower margin requirements and the futures rebound can cushion opening pressure, but 313 A-share advancers versus 5,236 decliners and the global technology rout remain the core risks. A synchronized stabilization in A/H chips, CPO and solar plus better breadth would confirm the rebound; a failed gap or renewed Korea weakness would keep the defensive stance. Source

Premarket Takeaway

Facts: at 09:30 the Shanghai Composite, Shenzhen Component and Hang Seng Tech were down 0.86%, 0.98% and 1.92%; selected new HSTECH constituents fell 2.45%-4.71%.

View: expanding HSTECH from 30 to 50 names is a medium-term passive-flow and advanced-manufacturing signal, but it only takes effect Dec. 7 and today's negative price action does not support chasing. Huayou and Tongwei receive only initial confirmation; COOEC and TFC are not upgraded.

Uncertainty: 09:30 is an opening snapshot rather than persistent price-volume confirmation; global technology de-risking, weak A-share breadth and pre-rebalance positioning can amplify volatility.

Stocks to Watch

Huayou Cobalt
603799.SH
Conditional watch
Facts and status: a RMB1.0-1.5bn buyback capped at RMB45 per share was published over the weekend. At 09:30 the shares were RMB29.07, up 2.00%, an initial but limited positive reaction.
Confirmation: outperform lithium and battery materials with stronger volume after the Nov. 23 open, followed by verifiable buyback execution.
Invalidation: a failed gap, continued underperformance or spreading weakness in lithium and electrical equipment keeps the name in observation.
COOEC
600583.SH
Conditional watch
Facts and status: the approximately $800m MM-EPIC2 contract has a 66-month construction period. At 09:30 the shares were RMB6.16, down 1.12%, a negative post-announcement reaction.
Confirmation: stronger volume and outperformance versus oil services after the open, plus continuing evidence on project execution.
Invalidation: lower oil, delivery or collection delays, or underperformance versus oil services cancels the watch.
TFC Optical
300394.SZ
Avoid
Facts and status: the planned high-speed optics project is not expected to materially affect 2026 earnings. At 09:30 the shares were RMB99.90, down 2.23%, while newly added HSTECH optical names also fell.
Reassessment: stabilize after disclosure, outperform CPO with stronger volume, and show verifiable orders, utilization or delivery progress.
Invalidation: continued global AI-hardware selling or a long realization cycle keeps the avoid status; the expansion headline cannot erase negative feedback.
Tongwei
600438.SH
Conditional watch
Facts and status: a RMB1.0-2.0bn buyback signal was disclosed over the weekend. At 09:30 the shares were RMB11.28, up 1.53%, an initial reaction that still faces the US solar industry's 10.37% negative counter-signal.
Reassessment: A-share solar stabilizes, Tongwei earns positive price and volume confirmation, and actual buyback trades or better industry pricing provide support.
Invalidation: continued solar underperformance, weak buyback execution or persistent supply-demand pressure keeps the avoid status.

Sector Rotation

Structural signal

HSTECH expansion broadens battery, optics, semiconductor equipment, AI infrastructure and advanced manufacturing exposure.

Initial confirmation

Huayou rose 2.00% and Tongwei 1.53%, only opening reactions that still require volume and sector-relative validation.

Pressure

Hang Seng Tech fell 1.92%, while Yangtze Optical Fibre, ASMPT, Innolight H and CATL H all declined; expansion did not create an immediate bullish confirmation.

Validation

Watch whether new constituents recover opening losses, HSTECH improves relative to HSI, and A-share technology and new-energy breadth strengthens.

Logic Chain

HSTECH expands 30→50 effective Dec. 7 → medium-term passive demand and coverage broaden → battery, optics, semiconductor equipment and AI infrastructure gain benchmark exposure.
New constituents broadly fall at 09:30 → flow expectations lack immediate confirmation → inclusion is not a same-day chase signal.
Huayou and Tongwei rise at the open → buyback signals receive initial feedback → persistence, sector-relative strength and execution still matter.
COOEC and TFC fall at the open → contract and expansion headlines do not erase negative price feedback → keep conditional or avoid status.

Risk Radar

Hang Seng Tech fell 1.92% and representative new constituents lost 2.45%-4.71%, with pre-rebalance volatility and profit-taking possible.
Shanghai and Shenzhen opened down 0.86% and 0.98%, so the extremely weak Nov. 20 breadth has not reversed.
Large negative feedback in US semiconductors, hardware and solar remains; index expansion does not reverse global technology de-risking.
The change only takes effect Dec. 7 and simulated weights are not guaranteed flows; tracking assets, free-float adjustments and prices can change.
09:30 is only an opening snapshot, and Huayou and Tongwei's positive reactions can fade; no return is implied.

Sources and Timestamp

Primary sources: SSE, SZSE, MIIT, MOFCOM, Hang Seng Indexes and statutory company filings, with incremental research through 2026-11-23 09:30 CST. Index changes follow Hang Seng Indexes' Nov. 20 quarterly review; opening quotes are a 09:30 CST snapshot from Eastmoney's public delayed endpoint. International and overnight sources: Reuters, AP, a CME futures media snapshot and the GitHub Actions Moomoo ranking snapshot. Updated: 2026-11-23 09:30 CST.
